description: List the visitors currently in a chat: which page they are on, their country, how long they have been there, and whether a human has taken the conversation over. Needs the Standard plan or higher.

limit.description: How many sessions to return (1-100, default 25).

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_active_sessions
title: List visitors chatting right now
